name: 06896 · Redding, CT
findings: ZIP 06896 (Redding) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06896 (Redding) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06896 (Redding) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
